title: Mistral AI and NVIDIA Launch Industrial Engineering AI Partnership
summary:
The collaboration will deliver new datasets for physics AI and accelerate simulation processes in the manufacturing sector. Mistral AI and NVIDIA are developing agentic AI evaluations for electronic design automation (EDA) and computer-aided engineering (CAE) to create AI-native engineering workflows powered by accelerated computing.

CEO Arthur Mensch described the deepened partnership as a key pillar of research to address the technical requirements of the industrial world. The initiative aims to transition humanity into a new technological era by integrating artificial intelligence into engineering processes.
